pattern.description: Both agent panes advance at once: the left pane appends a new reasoning paragraph and the right pane appends a 'pwd' tool step, and each conversation stack jumps up inside its fixed pane above the pinned 'Thinking...' footer.
pattern.why_premium: Parallel, independently scrolling panes make 'multiple agents working in the background' legible without any added graphics; the motion is honest product redraw, timed under the narration 'and in the background'.

build_hint.gsap: Two independent timelines in overflow:hidden panes: gsap.to('.left .stack', {y: '-=100', duration: 0.05, ease: 'steps(2)'}) with gsap.fromTo('.left .para:last-child', {autoAlpha: 0}, {autoAlpha: 1, duration: 0.03}, '<'); offset the right pane by ~1 frame: gsap.to('.right .stack', {y: '-=28', duration: 0.05, ease: 'steps(2)'}) plus gsap.fromTo('.right .step:last-child', {autoAlpha: 0}, {autoAlpha: 1, duration: 0.03}, '<').
build_hint.remotion: Per pane: translateY = interpolate(frame, [start, start + 2], [0, -shift], {extrapolateLeft: 'clamp', extrapolateRight: 'clamp'}); appended block opacity = frame >= start + 1 ? 1 : 0. Left and right panes use different start frames. No spring.

notes: Energy shows three separate spikes (frames ~2, 8-9, 16), so the two panes probably redraw at slightly different moments; which spike belongs to which pane is not separable from the filmstrip. Scroll amounts are visual estimates. Camera move is none.
